description: We are a group of students who are very interested in science and mathematics and we want to continue participating in new projects together. We have peculiar interests, discussing topics which are not so common for the age we have. Nevertheless, we are a group of friends who want to keep enjoying learning together.
summary: Our idea is to distribute this project to secondary schools all around the country because our target audience is middle and high schoolers, which is why our presentation is so visually appealing and fluid. We aim to instruct people our age in spatial knowledge in an innovative way, so realistically they will at least find the experience mildly entertaining. Our project consists of a narrative of a fictional 'Estalmar-ship' that orbits both the Moon and Mars, whilst Mariana (the astronaut) encounters forgotten gear from past NASA missions and simultaneously explains relevant details about the trip.
details:
We have used Canva, Prezi and Google sites to create our presentations. Our project is creative in storytelling, we have really worked on it. Also, our project is centered in innovation, creativity and impact. The impact we want to make on people our age is the importance of past missions, and the relevance the people that participated on them are important in history. WE CANNOT FORGET THEM.
We believe the benefits are: students get curious about these important missions, more people in related careers and deserved relevance to people involved in the missions. We want this project to go further creating more presentations or even creating an account on social media talking about it.
